scope: Official public field, metrology and catalogue sources reviewed for additional evidence that can strengthen the station-side digital twin without inventing a full-loop holdout.

sources.reported_scope: HyStEP in-use testing at 22 operating light-duty hydrogen stations, including fault, communication and fueling-performance checks against the HGV 4.3 / SAE J2601 basis.
public_material: example pressure, temperature, mass-flow and SOC figures
not_usable_for: dynamic pressure, temperature or mass-flow error scoring
sources.claim_limit: The public report is valuable field evidence, but the public record does not expose a rights-cleared common-clock logger archive or the Appendix A workbook as a reusable raw holdout.

sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.reported_scope: A transient-flow facility reproducing dispenser-like pressure, temperature and flow changes for hydrogen-refuelling metrology and flow-meter evaluation.
not_usable_for: full-loop consequence or SAGA effectiveness claims
sources.claim_limit: The official project description documents the facility and methods, but does not publish a reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle measurement cohort.

sources.reported_scope: Public catalogue for a real liquid-hydrogen refueling-station operating dataset with a concentrated 16-hour, one-second monitoring window and pressure, temperature, flow, dispensed-mass, compressor, storage and liquid-pump/tank file roles.
sources.claim_limit: The public catalogue and description establish a credible real-station data lead, but numerical files require a data application and vehicle/receptacle mapping, units, calibration and reuse terms are not yet verified.

next_action: Use all three sources to strengthen bounded protocol, instrumentation, data-access and LLM grounding checks; keep the independent full-loop gate open until a custodian supplies at least three de-identified synchronized events.
claim_boundary: This is a public-source classification record. It adds field and metrology context but does not establish a new validation pass, safety distance, accident frequency or journal readiness.
